{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kathol Republic Marines''' were a fighting force assigned to ships in the [[Kathol Republic Navy]]. There were typically twenty marines per squad, and each was equipped with a [[Blast helmet/Legends|blast helmet]] and [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vest]], a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].
